messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=runtime-inference region=us-west — metric: tail_latency_99 > 800ms for 3m :rotating_light:
Sam: acked the page, oncall here. seeing a p99 spike on the dashboards too. pausing alerts to avoid noise.
Priya: thanks. confirming customer impact? anything hitting 5xx?
Sam: error rate stable, mostly high token latency (p95 -> ~420ms, p99 -> ~1.1s). top traffic on v2-model routes.
Luca: checking recent deploys — nothing on runtime in last 6h. but model-variant rollout started ~30m ago (canary).
Maya: /whoami on canary controller shows 20% traffic to variant-q4. I'll repro the queue length graphs.
Sam: quick mitigation plan: 1) rollback canary -> reduce tail load 2) scale dedicated pool by +2 nodes 3) enable kv-cache prefix warming for hot keys.
Priya: agree. Initiating canary rollback now.
Sam: rollback started. logs show canary traffic drained.
OpsBot: autoscaler triggered +1 node in us-west; requested +1 more (manual) — ETA ~2m.
Luca: adding a temporary routing rule to divert new sessions to stable model: `route: if request.model_variant == q4 -> stable-v1` (applied).
Maya: kv-cache hitrate dip correlates. warming top-10 prefixes. command: ```./tools/warm_prefixes --keys=$(cat hot_keys.txt) --region us-west```
Priya: running the warm script now.
incident-bot: note: alert suppression enabled for tail_latency_99 for 10m to prevent cascade pages.
Sam: metrics updating — p99 dropping from 1.1s -> 730ms after rollback + scale. p95 at ~380ms.
Luca: load balancer shows steady traffic, no 5xx, queue depth back to normal.
Maya: customer-facing impact: none degraded to errors, a handful of sessions saw latency > 2s (about 12 sessions in last 10m). logging request ids for postmortem.
Priya: capturing sample traces and saving to /var/tmp/incident/1751119876/traces.tar.gz
Sam: good. keeping pages open for another 15m to watch for reappearance. please add any follow-ups here.
Luca: follow-up item: investigate why kv-cache warming is slow for variant-q4 (serialize warm path).
Maya: add an alert to detect warm-hit regressions for future.
Priya: ops note: if p99 back above 900ms re-open page and escalate to platform@redwood.
OpsBot: handed off to next oncall Sam -> Luca in 20m. Sam: please verbal handoff when you sign off.
Sam: handing off to Luca. summary: canary rollout increased tail due to cold kv-warm path; rolled back; scaled pool; warmed prefixes; p99 improved. keep an eye on warm hitrate and canary rollout shims.
Luca: acknowledged the handoff. continuing watch. tagging for postmortem: @sre-team @eng-runtime. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Thread closed automatically after 55m of inactivity.
